description: This is a Java test class for SecurePay service integration, containing unit tests for authorization, capture, refund, and credit operations within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SecurePayServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for SecurePay service operations in OFBiz framework.

methods.name: testAuth
methods.description: Tests the authorization process with SecurePay, verifies success, and stores response.

methods.name: testdoCapture
methods.description: Tests the capture operation after authorization, updates response reference number.

methods.name: testdoRefund
methods.description: Tests the refund process and verifies success.

methods.name: testdoCredit
methods.description: Tests the credit (refund to card) operation and verifies success.
